title: Session three: opening with Teddie Jones present
summary: A recording stop and Satin Doll CD remark; the interviewer opens session three on the evening of Nov 27 with Hank and Teddie Jones.

blocks.x: The title of the CD was called “Satin Doll,” it was all the Duke Ellington compositions solo.

Well, here we go again. It is the evening of November 27 we are now about to start session 3 of the Hank Jones interview for the Smithsonian Jazz Oral History Program. My name is William A Brauer Jr. the engineer for this session is Sven Abo. I'm interviewing Henry William Jones Junior, and his wife Teddie, if I may call you Teddie.
